test_title: PYST 42: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All Tractors are Buses.

No Buses are Trucks.

Conclusions:

I. No Trucks are Tractors.

II. Some Trucks are Tractors.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram will be as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7a2167f69b67bdd285136df83c492429ac1fd1b07271d14626d3337387dbd3f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No Trucks are Tractors. - True (All Tractors are Buses.No Buses are Trucks.Hence, it is True)

II. Some Trucks are Tractors. - False (As their is no direct relation between Trucks and Tractors may be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

Only conclusion (I) follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
